newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Schindler aims at 160 mln sfr in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Schindler aims at 160 mln sfr in 1997.

text.p: Swiss machinery concern Schindler Group expected profits in 1997 to show a positive result of around 160 million Swiss francs, excluding non-recurring costs of at least 25 million Swiss francs.

Schindler, reporting its 1996 earnings, said it expected the elevator and escalator market in Asia to continue to grow, and said it expected a slight rebound in North American and Latin American markets.

It said however that an improvement in most European markets, with respect to demand and prices, was "not yet in sight". But introduction of new products in the spring of 1997 were expected to strengthen its sales potential in Europe.
It also expected productivity in its European Group companies to improve on a sustained basis.

"In view of the scenario outlined above -- assuming stable foreign exchange and economic baseline conditions -- and on the basis of positive results generated in 1996, Schindler is still aiming for a 1997 profitability level on par with 1993/94, i.e. about 160 million (Swiss francs), not counting non-recurring costs of at least 25 million," it said.
